method.static: ripgrep over src/ and public/ for localStorage, sessionStorage, IndexedDB, Cache API, service worker, window.name, Supabase tables, file download/export, and request logging
method.runtime: enumerated every localStorage key and every IndexedDB database in the live browser session after real use (chat turn, memory deletion, project seeding, two restarts)

runtimeObservation.note: Cache Storage and the service worker are only active in a production build (src/main.tsx registers sw.js when IS_PROD). Their caching scope was audited in source, not observed at runtime here.

pathways.deletionMechanism: ProjectStore.forgetText (M22.4, quote-targeted) + ResidueMigration.redact (M22.5/M22.6, tombstone-proven) + clearCheckpoint on explicit review
pathways.recallProtection: DeletionGuard scrubs checkpoint summary/next action/pending and hides projects whose name quotes a deletion (buildCognitiveContext)
pathways.verification: tests/memory-integrity.test.ts A,E,G,I,K; MISSION-22.6/verification.json scenarios B,C,D,F,G,I; browser boot healing

pathways.dataType: ResponsePattern records (prompt, response, keywords, context.origin, context.history)
pathways.deletionMechanism: PatternMemory.remove / clear (record delete); Brain records the tombstone BEFORE removal; a deleted id can never be re-added
pathways.migrationCoverage: not applicable — the record is removed, not rewritten; the ledger is the durable proof
pathways.recallProtection: PatternMemory.search drops records quoting a tombstone (superseded/merged copies) and any record whose id is tombstoned
pathways.verification: scenario A (row absent from IndexedDB), scenario H (absent after restart), tests C,D,L

pathways.dataType: conversation list and message text (user + assistant turns, summaries)
pathways.deletionMechanism: forgetConversation purges the chat and its session memories; the transcript itself is the user's own conversation and is not rewritten by a single-memory deletion
pathways.recallProtection: MemoryBridge.sanitizeMessages removes tombstoned sentences from every dialogue turn except the newest user message
pathways.verification: browser payload: 28,752-byte provider request contained zero occurrences of the deleted phrase; test E
pathways.status: PARTIALLY COVERED — recall protected, stored transcript not rewritten (deliberate; see known-limitations L2)

pathways.dataType: current thread window (last topic, recent messages)
pathways.deletionMechanism: rebuilt per session; the shared window is not persisted long-term

pathways.dataType: tombstones: id, timestamp, conversation id, hashed 6-token windows, size, token count
pathways.memoryDerived: derived, not recoverable — no statement, token or reversible form is stored
pathways.deletionMechanism: append-only, bounded to 400 entries; `discard` only as compensation for a failed record removal
pathways.verification: tests A,B; scenario A/H; browser: ledger key holds no deleted text

pathways.dataType: migration report (counts, locations, reasons), cursor, review dispositions
pathways.memoryDerived: no deleted text: previews are stripped before persisting (M22.6)
pathways.deletionMechanism: cursor cleared on completion; report overwritten by the next applied run
pathways.verification: test I (persisted report does not contain record text); scenario F

pathways.deletionMechanism: overwritten each boot; lease released at the end of a run
pathways.verification: browser evidence (state complete, no text); verification.storage dump

pathways.dataType: self-description, learned knowledge, curiosity topics, daily record
pathways.deletionMechanism: none targeted — these are derived views, rewritten as the app learns
pathways.recallProtection: self-model knows/goals are filtered by DeletionGuard at context assembly
pathways.verification: code path + context scrub test K; no end-to-end proof that every derived entry is covered
pathways.status: PARTIALLY COVERED — context filtered, stored derived text not rewritten (L3)

pathways.key: lelu.usage.v1, lelu.notifications.history.v1, lelu.lelu.runtime.activity.v1, lelu.lelu.selfstudy.trace.v1, lelu.lelu.improvements.v1, lelu.lelu.toolstats.v1, lelu.lelu.reflection.*
pathways.implementation: usage accounting, notification history, runtime activity, self-study trace, improvement queue, reflection
pathways.dataType: labels, counts, short status strings, objective titles
pathways.memoryDerived: possible — a tool result or objective title can echo user text
pathways.recallProtection: only what is assembled into context is guarded; these keys are not all read into prompts
pathways.status: UNAUDITED FOR CONTENT — flagged in known-limitations L4

pathways.recallProtection: profile reaches prompts through identity, not through the guarded memory path

pathways.verification: database present in runtime inventory; no text content

pathways.dataType: same-origin GET navigations and static assets (stale-while-revalidate); model assets deliberately bypass it
pathways.deletionMechanism: version bump replaces the cache; no API responses are cached (non-GET requests return early)
pathways.verification: source (GET-only guard) + runtime: 0 cache entries, 0 registrations in the dev session

pathways.dataType: the marker `lelu:<workspaceKey>:genesisv2`; a legacy build could have left a full JSON value here
pathways.deletionMechanism: KvStore reads a legacy value once and copies it into localStorage/sessionStorage (which are swept); nothing is written to window.name by KvStore
pathways.verification: source; dormant legacy value is not observable without a pre-M22 environment
pathways.status: PARTIALLY COVERED — dormant legacy payload migrates into a swept backend on read (L5)

pathways.dataType: mirror rows of local memories, including prompt/response text
pathways.deletionMechanism: SupabasePersistence.forgetMemory(id) called from AIService.forgetMemory and forgetConversation (M22.6, best-effort, contained)
pathways.tombstoneCoverage: local only — the remote row is deleted, not tombstoned
pathways.recallProtection: hydration cannot restore a tombstoned id (PatternMemory.add) and the context guard filters the external provider's rows
pathways.verification: test L (restore refused); code path for the delete is not exercised — no Supabase account in this environment
pathways.status: PARTIALLY VERIFIED — deletion implemented, cloud path untested here (L6)

pathways.dataType: server-side memory rows for the OG surface
pathways.deletionMechanism: row delete through the OG panel; records no tombstone
pathways.recallProtection: if the same text is also held locally with a tombstone, the guard filters it; an OG-only deletion is invisible to the ledger

pathways.storageAuthority: Model broker request log (server process stdout)
pathways.dataType: one line per turn: provider, model, status, byte count, message count, token estimates — explicitly no prompt text
pathways.deletionMechanism: process stdout only; no file persistence in the app
pathways.verification: source inspected; the log format excludes message content

pathways.dataType: documents, images, models, spreadsheets the user asks to download
pathways.deletionMechanism: outside the app's storage once downloaded
pathways.verification: source audit; no automatic export of memory

pathways.dataType: files written by engineering tooling inside the sandbox workspace
pathways.memoryDerived: possible if the user asks LÉLU to write a file containing a remembered statement
pathways.status: OUT OF SCOPE BY DESIGN — user-authored files are not memory
